why: The lookahead's own rung under ADR 0066, the first since it lost its standing. Under stacked picks it beat greedy 0.755; once a creature buys one package an opportunity it scores 0.383, and #184 traced the gap to both of its readings, the intent and the target, not to a bug: a Wait lure it fell into cost nothing measurable once fixed. Its rollout reads a round through the built-in weights, which were set for the one-step reading and never searched for this one under the new rule, so this search fits the weights to the reading that plays them: every candidate plays as `lookahead:<weights>`, starting from the built-in set. The panel is greedy, search-4 and random, a candidate ranking last if it falls below the start against any: greedy because it is the opponent the lookahead now loses to, search-4 because search 10 showed a panel without it can be learned rather than the game, random as the floor. The check, off that line, is stun-first. The budget is 6 rounds of 12, smaller than the heuristic rungs', because a lookahead evaluation costs about four and a half times a heuristic one and the workflow stops at three hours. What would make it a rung: a set that, played as the lookahead, beats greedy on seeds it never saw, where the built-in weights read 0.383, and holds the check. The tell to read first: against greedy, how many mirrored pairs the dice decide (174 of 200 for search 10's heuristic set); if nearly all, the greedy column is a coin and the search ranks on the other two.
